intended_construction: For a smooth manifold M and natural degree k, real de Rham cohomology is the quotient of closed smooth differential k-forms by exact k-forms, with well-definedness resting on d composed with d being zero.
foundation_profile: Lean 4 dependent type theory; classical and quotient requirements not frozen
tcb_profile: Lean kernel, repository toolchain, and pinned mathlib expected; exact import closure open
computation_profile: noncomputable quotient construction expected; not frozen
domain_and_universes: A smooth finite-dimensional manifold M, coefficient field provisionally R, and k : Nat; model, regularity, boundary, and universe parameters remain open.
conclusion: No exact proposition selected; intended object is ker(d_k) / im(d_(k-1)).
excluded_degenerate_cases: Not frozen; degree zero, empty manifolds, manifolds with boundary, and negative predecessor indexing require explicit decisions.
